Zoe (People Ops): Heads-up from a manager: candidate got an unexpected off-cycle bump that would push them just over band midpoint. Need routing + timeline.
Carlos Rivera (Manager): Yep. Approved a 12% increase today (US). It crosses midpoint by a hair. Do I need Comp sign-off or is People Ops OK to proceed? Also what effective date do we use if we want it in this month?
Mei Lin (Comp & Rewards): For US: if change crosses midpoint or is a market correction, comp-ops review is required. 12% alone doesn't auto-block, but crossing midpoint does. Please open comp-ops ticket referencing the HR ticket.
Isaac - Payroll: Payroll cutoffs for US: submit signed docs 2 business days before run. If you want this month, we need everything in by EOD two business days prior. If missed, we run next cycle and process retro.
Carlos Rivera (Manager): OK. What docs exactly should I attach so comp-ops can triage fast?
Zoe (People Ops): Copy this checklist into your HR ticket.
```
- Employee full name + ID
- Manager approval (name + date)
- Current salary + proposed salary (annual)
- Band/level and new placement
- Reason for change (merit / market / promotion)
- Evidence (benchmarks, promotion rubric excerpt)
- Signed comp change form (attach)
- Contract amendment (if salary is contractual)
- Effective date (yyyy-mm-dd)
- Retro justification (if effective in past)
- Tags: comp-ops, payroll, legal (if contract)
```
Carlos Rivera (Manager): Thanks. If comp-ops approves after payroll cutoff, can we still do retro same-month?
Mei Lin (Comp & Rewards): If comp-ops approval comes after payroll cutoff, payroll will schedule retro for the next cycle. Retro pay date depends on cross-border approvals; US typical is next cycle. Anything >6 months needs Director approval.
Lena (Legal): Quick legal note: if the employee's offer letter references base salary explicitly, issue an amendment and get signature. Use Confluence template. For international hires, check statutory rules with local counsel.
Isaac - Payroll: Attach everything to the HR ticket (do not email PDFs individually). Once comp-ops signs off tag payroll and we'll confirm expected payroll cycle.
Carlos Rivera (Manager): Filing HR-4219 now and tagging comp-ops. Thanks team.
people-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff calendar is pinned in #people-ops/payschedule.
